acceptance.given: The frozen Package A source contains the A1-A4 implementation-binding table with each group's declared intent range, Q2 test owner, production owner, and predecessor dependencies.

oracle.expected: A deterministic binding-validation artifact preserves A1-A4 as non-published suggestions and records the exact declared intent ranges, Q2 test owners, production owners, and predecessor dependency edges.
forbidden: Any group omits or changes its declared intent coverage, Q2 test owner, production owner, or predecessor dependency.
Any artifact treats A1-A4 labels as published slice or evidence identities.
Any group executes without its declared predecessors.
oracle.observable: The binding-validation check emits a structured result containing all A1-A4 fields and an explicit suggestion-only classification; altered metadata produces a field-specific failure.

acceptance.then: The validation result reports exact preservation of A1-A4 metadata and suggestion-only semantics, or reports a field-specific contract failure.
acceptance.when: During Package A plan compilation or binding validation after parsing the frozen implementation-binding section.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute the existing binding-validation test selector against a fixture with one altered A1-A4 intent range, owner, dependency, or published-identity flag and assert a structured field-specific failure.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Validate that the frozen A1-A4 implementation bindings remain exact, dependency-ordered suggestions rather than published identities.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Revert the binding-validation logic only; no persisted runtime state or schema migration is required.

slice_hint.state_transition: The frozen suggestion table is parsed, checked against expected A1-A4 metadata, and emitted as non-authoritative implementation guidance.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Binding validation passes only when all A1-A4 intent ranges, Q2 owners, production owners, predecessor dependencies, and suggestion-only semantics exactly match the frozen source.
